Row.Cell: Give Mutt a sniff of any herb — fresh or dried — and command him to Track. He'll lead you to a living plant of that kind growing nearby.
给穆特闻一闻任意药草——新鲜或晒干的都行——再下令追踪。他会带你找到附近还长着的那一种。
After enough hours napping in herb patches, even a hunting dog starts to dream in green.
在药圃边打了够多的盹，猎犬也会开始梦见绿色。
